_doc: clinic-hold-lapses — the honesty of the hold itself.
hold_slot() is the only write an agent can make, and the claim on the page is that it books
NOTHING: it auto-releases and the slot returns to the board. This case waits out the full
45-second TTL without touching the keyboard and asserts the slot is open again, that nothing
was booked, and that clinic_hold_status reports no hold. If a hold ever quietly became a
booking, this is the case that fails.

eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-slot-state="open"]'); window.__s = el && el.getAttribute('data-clinic-slot'); return typeof window.__s; })()
